verdict.rationale: Versioned APIs and a deprecation policy are a fair question for an inference server that exposes OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic Messages and gRPC APIs, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documented API versioning scheme or deprecation policy. A release-version note on a feature (`required` tool_choice as of vllm>=0.8.3) is a changelog-style mention, not an API versioning or deprecation commitment.
